articles.summary: We’ve rolled out major performance improvements for our DOCX conversion service. If your product supports Word files using Tiptap, this update makes things a lot smoother.
articles.title: Faster, lighter, and more reliable DOCX import/export with Tiptap

articles.summary: Build AI-powered rich text editing workflows in minutes, not weeks.
articles.title: Introducing the Tiptap AI Agent

articles.summary: We quietly rolled out a new pricing model for Tiptap Cloud a few weeks ago. It’s now live and fully in effect. Over the next weeks, we’ll keep reaching out to existing users directly. But we also want to share the reasoning behind this change more broadly.
articles.title: Tiptap’s new pricing model is live

articles.summary: We’ve made big upgrades to how Tiptap handles DOCX files — import, export, formatting, styling, and custom node conversion all got better. If you're dealing with Word files in your app, these changes mean fewer edge cases, better results, and more control.
articles.title: Improved DOCX Import & Export in Tiptap

articles.summary: We’ve got some great news for the Tiptap community. By the end of June, we’re open-sourcing several extensions that were previously part of our paid “Pro” tier. They’ll be released under the MIT license and will be completely free to use.
articles.title: We’re open-sourcing more of Tiptap
